method.method_draft: First describe the visual structure: an R-substituted epoxide ring with a -CH2O^- side chain on the other epoxide carbon, and stereochemistry indicated on both ring carbons. Then choose a SMILES traversal starting at the R group wildcard, go to the first chiral epoxide carbon, close the three-membered ring through O to the second chiral carbon, and append the CH2 alkoxide substituent. Applying the depicted stereochemistry for this traversal gives '*[C@@H]1O[C@@H]1C[O-]'.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中可见一个三元环氧结构：环内有一个氧原子和两个环碳，左侧环碳连着一个 R 取代基，右侧环碳连着一个 -CH2O^- 侧链；两个环碳都标出了立体化学，图中的弯箭头按题意忽略。推理时把 R 取代基写作通配符 *，从 * 出发连接到第一个手性环碳，经过环氧氧原子到第二个手性环碳并闭合三元环，再接上 -CH2O^- 侧链。按该遍历和图示构型，对应 SMILES 为 *[C@@H]1O[C@@H]1C[O-]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-transcription route: it reads the molecular graph and stereochemical wedges from the image, then encodes that exact graph into isomeric SMILES. No alternative chemical mechanism or answer-elimination step is needed.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the image first, ignoring the curved arrows. Identify a three-membered epoxide ring with ring oxygen between two stereogenic carbons; the left epoxide carbon bears an R substituent, and the right/lower epoxide carbon bears a -CH2-O^- substituent. Note the drawn wedge/dash stereochemical orientation at the two ring carbons as shown.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read the question instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and explicitly says to ignore the arrows; there is no other textual chemical data to extract.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent an unspecified R group as wildcard '*'; encode the epoxide as a three-membered ring using ring index '1' in the path *-C1-O-C1; put explicit chirality on the two tetrahedral ring carbons with bracketed [C@@H] for the chosen traversal; encode the terminal alkoxide oxygen as [O-]. Curved arrows are not atoms/bonds and must be omitted.
